basis: Step 1 of the provenance rule (AFC-194 section 3): the claim registry that the step 2 isolation layer reads, plus the --check-commit mode that enforces R1 and R2 mechanically. AFC-175 built the dirty-tree mode and closed; the registry and the commit mode were its unfinished half and are landed here because AFC-196 is the issue that consumes them.
notCompliancePath: scripts/dirty-path-guard.sh is NOT on the R2 list. R2 names scripts/retention-literal-gate.sh specifically, not all of scripts/. This file is on the DIRTY list (all of scripts/) and not on the R2 list; conflating the two lists would demand a reviewer on every script in the repo. Asserted by self-test 9e.
doesNotClaim: This claim asserts who wrote the change. It is not a licence and it cannot exempt anything.
